tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open roles at sports technology companies (sports data, betting tech, wearables, fan engagement, ticketing, performance analytics, fitness tech, clubs and leagues). Listings are refreshed daily from employers' own job feeds. Filter by free text (title, company, city or country), region, job f

tools.name: list_hiring_companies
tools.description: List sports technology companies ranked by how many open roles they have, with how many roles each added in the last 30 days. Optionally filter by region or job function.

tools.name: subscribe_to_job_alerts
tools.description: Sign an email address up for Jobs in Sports Tech job alert emails, optionally with preferred regions and job functions. Use only with the user's own email address, given by the user for this purpose. The address is stored with the stated preferences only; every email includes an unsubscribe link.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs · Public sink: subscribe_to_job_alerts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs · Public sink: subscribe_to_job_alerts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
